mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate during late-cycle expansion signals accommodative monetary policy, compressing discount rates on equity cash flows and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in >60% of triggered instances despite negative signal (e.g., FEDFUNDS rising), or Rank IC <0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: An unexpected rise in unemployment rate above 4% triggers a loss of labor market confidence, reducing corporate investment and S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX returns positive when UNRATE crosses threshold, or p-value >0.05 in t-test over 3-month window.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent growth in both demand (GDPC1) and supply (INDPRO) indices signals a robust economic expansion, boosting equity valuations and S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: both GDPC1 and INDPRO increase over next 20d
failure_condition: Returns negative when one proxy rises while the other falls, or IC <0.03 over 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate during late-cycle expansion signals accommodative monetary policy, compressing discount rates on equity cash flows and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: In late-cycle expansion, FEDFUNDS decline doesn't correlate with positive returns (p>0.05), or returns positive in non-late-cycle periods despite the signal.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in the supply index (INDPRO) above 110 (2017=100) indicates robust production capacity, lowering inflationary pressures and driving S&P 500 returns positively over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Returns not positive when INDPRO crosses threshold, or IC <0.03 over 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent labor market tightening (UNRATE <4%) and monetary easing (FEDFUNDS decline) create a dual signal of strong demand and accommodative policy, amplifying S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: Returns not positive when both conditions met, or IC <0.03 over 1-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A long-term upward trend in the supply index (INDPRO) reflects sustained production growth, reducing supply bottlenecks and driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: INDPRO rising but returns not positive over 60d, or IC <0.03 over 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A sudden spike in labor demand (PAYEMS exceeding 1.5 million in three months) indicates accelerated hiring, boosting corporate profits and S&P 500 returns within the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: Returns not positive when PAYEMS spikes, or p-value >0.05 in t-test over 3-month window.
